observations.body: A dispute about greatness arises; Jesus contrasts Gentile rulers with the greatest becoming like the younger and the leader like one who serves, then speaks of kingdom, table, and thrones.
observations.label: A dispute over greatness is answered by service and table promise

observations.body: The passage presents Serving at the table as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Serving at the table

observations.body: The passage places Eating, drinking, and judging in the kingdom beside Serving at the table.
observations.label: Eating, drinking, and judging in the kingdom

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:24–30 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.title: A dispute over greatness is answered by service and table promise
